about_the_game:
Get a sneak peek into the deep with the Octopus Invasion Demo — a bite-sized introduction to the full underwater adventure.

In this demo, you'll:

  • Complete the Tutorial level, learning how to swim, hunt, and evolve your octopus.

  • Play through Level 1, where you’ll start devouring smaller fish, unlock your first upgrades, and experience the early game ecosystem.

The demo is designed to give players a feel for the core mechanics: feeding, evolving, and exploring the ocean. It does not include later biomes, advanced upgrades, quests, or boss encounters — those are available in the full game.

Key Features in the Demo:

  • 🌊 Tutorial + Level 1 gameplay

  • 🐠 Hunt and eat small sea creatures

  • 🧬 Unlock early-stage mutations

  • 🕹️ Try both controller and keyboard/mouse support

  • 🎮 Steam Deck optimized

This demo offers just a taste of what's to come — in the full game, you’ll explore six biomes, evolve along different paths, complete quests, and dominate the ocean as an apex predator.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur (11.0) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1 chip
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 6100 or Apple integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Monterey (12.0) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1/M2 chip
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics (AMD Radeon Pro 560 or equivalent Apple Silicon GPU)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
